mechanism_narrative: A high and rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) signals persistent price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is high and rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 3.5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 thousand units, it indicates strong consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a rapidly tightening labor market that may lead to wage-driven inflation and central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not produce negative returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105 for two consecutive months signals a manufacturing slowdown that may indicate recessionary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 105 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), a decline in CPIAUCSL signals effective policy tightening and reduced inflation fears, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines during FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a healthy manufacturing sector that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
